articles.summary: While multimodal agents now carry out complex data analysis with tools, their ability to turn decades of satellite imagery into reliable land-change analysis, crucial for Earth observation science, remains unmeasured. articles.summary: Dexterous manipulation requires rich spatial foresight over both the surrounding scene and the robot hand. articles.summary: Protein engineering requires navigating rugged fitness landscapes, where small sequence changes can produce large functional differences, but experimental screening can only sample a small fraction of sequence space. articles.summary: Memory-augmented vision-language-action (VLA) policies are meant to remember what happened. articles.title: onóna: Twin Embeddings with Tied Unembeddings

articles.summary: Many of the most consequential advances promised by AI, from curing diseases and inventing new technologies to formulating new scientific theories, are fundamentally creative acts.
